items.quote: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.
items.contrast: The stated reason—certainty that the Lord’s message would come true—versus the preceding fact that he had buried the man of God.
items.reason: The word “For” directly connects the burial request to the certainty that the man of God’s message will be fulfilled. The stem clearly asks for that reason, not merely what happened beforehand.
